description.value:
You unleash a beam of corrosive energy at a target within range, which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 10d6 + 40 acid damage. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated, leaving behind only a pile of fine dust along with anything unenhanced it wore or carried; a creature destroyed this way cannot be restored to life.

This power automatically disintegrates an unenhanced object of Large size or smaller, or a 10-foot-cube section of a larger object.

Cast with a tech slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
